sample_texts.50: Artificial intelligence is transforming how we work and live every day.
sample_texts.100: Machine translation systems use neural networks to convert text from one language to another with high accuracy.
sample_texts.200: The development of transformer-based models has significantly improved the quality of machine translation. These models can capture long-range dependencies in text and produce more fluent translations compared to earlier approaches.
sample_texts.500: In recent years, the field of natural language processing has witnessed remarkable progress. Neural machine translation systems, powered by deep learning architectures such as the Transformer, have become the dominant approach for building production-grade translation services. These systems are trained on large parallel corpora and can generalize well to diverse domains. However, challenges remain in handling low-resource languages, preserving context in long documents, and ensuring fairness across different dialects and cultural expressions.
